question: How does abstaining from food by day affect death associated with aging?
premises: There is abstention from eating by day
Death associated with age is confronted
The practitioner will go beyond it
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death associated with aging
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may imply overcoming or approaching depending on context
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome death due to aging.
